leakage_demo.protocol: CNN seed 0, config configs/cnn_leak.json; windows of 2048 samples, stride 512, metrics on positions >= 512. random: windows of ALL profiles split 80/10/10 at random, metrics on held-out windows (overlapping windows of the same profile are in train). profile: model trained on profile split P1, metrics on windows of the test profiles (and on the full test profiles).

export.latency_notes: streaming_step_window_rf: the ONNX model is stateless, so one new sample is answered by feeding the last receptive-field window (1023 samples) and reading the last output; sequence_1024: 1024 outputs in one call; single_sample_no_context: a (1,1,8) call, valid only as a lower bound on call overhead (no history, so not a usable prediction). CPU, onnxruntime, single intra-op thread by default.
